name: rivsto
notes: Always first; values are map-grid fields in the main restart.

name: fldsto
notes: Always second; values are map-grid fields in the main restart.

name: rivout_pre
notes: Normal Restart state used by the next-step flow calculation; omitted in Storage-only mode because an assimilation-updated storage state may not have corresponding previous-step flow. JPRB is 4-byte with SinglePrec_CMF and 8-byte otherwise; Binary file precision is independently selected by LRESTDBL.

name: fldout_pre
notes: Normal Restart state used by the next-step flow calculation; omitted in Storage-only mode because an assimilation-updated storage state may not have corresponding previous-step flow. JPRB is 4-byte with SinglePrec_CMF and 8-byte otherwise; Binary file precision is independently selected by LRESTDBL.

name: rivdph_pre
notes: Restored for Normal Restart; omitted in Storage-only mode
column13: which restarts from available storage state rather than a complete previous-step hydraulic state. JPRB is 4-byte with SinglePrec_CMF and 8-byte otherwise; Binary file precision is independently selected by LRESTDBL.

name: fldsto_pre
notes: Restored for Normal Restart; Storage-only mode instead initializes previous floodplain storage from the loaded current floodplain storage. JPRB is 4-byte with SinglePrec_CMF and 8-byte otherwise; Binary file precision is independently selected by LRESTDBL.

name: gdwsto
notes: Stored/read when groundwater delay is enabled; its physical record number shifts when preceding optional fields are absent or LSTOONLY omits four records.

name: damsto
notes: Stored/read when reservoir operation is enabled; its physical record number shifts when preceding optional fields are absent or LSTOONLY omits four records.

name: levsto
long_name: Storage on the protected side of levees
notes: Stored/read when the levee scheme is enabled; its physical record number shifts when preceding optional fields are absent or LSTOONLY omits four records.

name: pthflw_pre
condition: LPTHOUT; NetCDF variable only when not LSTOONLY
storage_only: Storage-only Binary writes the separate file but read skips it; NetCDF omits it
notes: Separate NPTHOUT x NPTHLEV data, not an NX x NY map. Binary storage-only reader initializes it to zero and does not read the .pth file.
